content.title: Check Rate Limit Declarations in OpenAPI

faqs.question: What HTTP status code should be returned when a rate limit is exceeded?
faqs.answer: Always return HTTP status code 429 Too Many Requests along with a Retry-After header indicating how many seconds the client must wait.
